title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A1–B1）
section: 第 101–150 個單字（CEFR A1 基礎入門）

examples.en: My dad washes his car every Sunday.
examples.zh: 我爸爸每週日都洗車。

examples.en: It is difficult to find a parking space for your car downtown.
examples.zh: 在市中心很難為你的車找到停車位。

examples.en: We decided to rent a car for our road trip across the island.
examples.zh: 我們決定租一輛車在島上展開公路旅行。

examples.en: We waited at the bus stop for twenty minutes.
examples.zh: 我們在公車站牌等了二十分鐘。

examples.en: You can tap your transportation card when you board the bus.
examples.zh: 上公車時你可以感應交通卡。

examples.en: The number 285 bus takes you directly to the museum.
examples.zh: 285 路公車可以直接載你到博物館。

examples.en: The train from Taipei to Kaohsiung is very fast.
examples.zh: 從台北到高雄的火車非常快。

examples.en: We need to train hard to win the championship.
examples.zh: 我們需要努力訓練才能贏得冠軍。

examples.en: Be sure to arrive at the train platform five minutes before departure.
examples.zh: 務必在發車前五分鐘抵達火車月台。

examples.en: Taking the MRT is very convenient in Taipei.
examples.zh: 在台北搭捷運非常方便。

examples.en: Eating and drinking are strictly prohibited on the MRT.
examples.zh: 捷運系統內嚴格禁止飲食。

examples.en: Which MRT line should I transfer to for the night market?
examples.zh: 我應該轉乘哪條捷運路線去夜市？

examples.en: YouBike is a popular bicycle rental system in Taiwan.
examples.zh: YouBike 是台灣受歡迎的公共自行車系統。

examples.en: Riding a bicycle along the riverside is a wonderful weekend activity.
examples.zh: 週末沿著河濱騎腳踏車是一項很棒的活動。

examples.en: Remember to lock your bike when you park it outside.
examples.zh: 將腳踏車停在室外時記得上鎖。

examples.en: Many people ride scooters to work in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 在台灣許多人騎機車上班。

examples.en: Always wear a safety helmet when riding a scooter.
examples.zh: 騎機車時一定要配戴安全帽。

examples.en: Scooters make it easy to weave through busy city traffic.
examples.zh: 機車讓人很容易穿梭在繁忙的市區車流中。

examples.en: Let's call a taxi because it's raining heavily.
examples.zh: 下大雨了，我們叫計程車吧。

examples.en: Yellow taxis can be flagged down easily on the street.
examples.zh: 黃色計程車在街上很容易隨招隨停。

examples.en: The taxi driver was very friendly and recommended great local restaurants.
examples.zh: 計程車司機非常友善，還推薦了很棒的在地美食。

examples.en: We watched the airplane take off at the airport.
examples.zh: 我們在機場看著飛機起飛。

examples.en: Please turn your mobile phones to airplane mode during flight.
examples.zh: 飛行期間請將手機轉為飛航模式。

examples.en: It takes about three hours by plane from Taipei to Tokyo.
examples.zh: 從台北搭飛機到東京大約需要三個小時。

examples.en: We took a boat tour around Sun Moon Lake.
examples.zh: 我們搭船遊覽日月潭。

examples.en: The fishermen returned to port with their small wooden boats.
examples.zh: 漁夫們划著他們的小木船返回港口。

examples.en: A rowing boat is available for rent in the park.
examples.zh: 公園裡有提供划艇租借。

examples.en: A huge cargo ship entered the harbor.
examples.zh: 一艘巨大的貨輪駛入了港口。

examples.en: The company will ship your order within two business days.
examples.zh: 公司將在兩個工作天內運送您的訂單。

examples.en: We took a luxury cruise ship to explore the Mediterranean islands.
examples.zh: 我們搭乘豪華郵輪探索地中海群島。

examples.en: I will meet you at Main Station at noon.
examples.zh: 我中午在台北車站跟你碰面。

examples.en: The police station is right next to the post office.
examples.zh: 警察局就在郵局隔壁。

examples.en: We stopped at a gas station to refuel the vehicle.
examples.zh: 我們停在加油站給車子加油。

examples.en: Taoyuan International Airport is very busy.
examples.zh: 桃園國際機場非常繁忙。

examples.en: We arrived at the airport two hours before our flight.
examples.zh: 我們在航班起飛前兩小時抵達機場。

examples.en: An airport express train links the terminal directly to the city center.
examples.zh: 機場快捷列車將航廈直接連結至市中心。

examples.en: The bus stops right in front of the school.
examples.zh: 公車剛好停在學校正前方。

examples.en: Please stop talking and open your textbooks to page ten.
examples.zh: 請停止講話，並翻開課本第十頁。

examples.en: There is a red stop sign at the street intersection.
examples.zh: 街角十字路口有一個紅色的停車標誌。

examples.en: Let's go home together after class.
examples.zh: 放學後我們一起回家吧。

examples.en: Do you want to go shopping at the department store this weekend?
examples.zh: 這個週末你想去百貨公司逛街嗎？

examples.en: Time goes by so quickly when you are having fun.
examples.zh: 玩得開心時時間過得真快。

examples.en: Welcome! Come in and sit down.
examples.zh: 歡迎！請進來坐下。

examples.en: Where do you come from originally?
examples.zh: 你最初來自哪裡？

examples.en: Dreams come true if you work persistently towards them.
examples.zh: 只要持之以恆努力，夢想就會實現。

examples.en: I like to walk my dog in the park.
examples.zh: 我喜歡在公園裡溜狗散步。

examples.en: It is healthy to take a twenty-minute walk after dinner.
examples.zh: 晚餐後散步二十分鐘對身體很有益處。

examples.en: We decided to walk to the museum instead of taking the bus.
examples.zh: 我們決定走路去博物館而不是搭公車。

examples.en: He runs three kilometers every morning.
examples.zh: 他每天早上跑三公里。

examples.en: Don't run in the school hallway, or you might trip and fall.
examples.zh: 不要在學校走廊奔跑，否則可能會絆倒受傷。

examples.en: His uncle has run a successful family restaurant for twenty years.
examples.zh: 他的叔叔經營一間成功的家族餐廳已有二十年。

examples.en: My mother learned to drive last year.
examples.zh: 我媽媽去年學會了開車。

examples.en: Always drive carefully and obey the local speed limits.
examples.zh: 開車務必謹慎，並遵守當地的速限。

examples.en: We went for a scenic drive along the northeast coast.
examples.zh: 我們開車沿著東北角海岸進行了一趟風景兜風。

examples.en: Children love to ride bikes in the yard.
examples.zh: 小朋友們喜歡在院子裡騎腳踏車。

examples.en: Can you give me a ride to the train station tomorrow?
examples.zh: 你明天可以順路載我一程去火車站嗎？

examples.en: He learned how to ride a horse during summer camp.
examples.zh: 他在夏令營期間學會了騎馬。

examples.en: Birds can fly high in the blue sky.
examples.zh: 鳥兒能在藍天中展翅高飛。

examples.en: We will fly to Tokyo for our vacation next Monday.
examples.zh: 我們下週一將搭飛機前往東京度假。

examples.en: The children love to fly kites on windy autumn afternoons.
examples.zh: 孩子們喜歡在多風的秋日午後放風箏。

examples.en: The traffic light turned red, so we stopped.
examples.zh: 紅綠燈變紅燈了，所以我們停了下來。

examples.en: She wore a bright red coat that stood out in the snow.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件亮紅色的外套，在雪地中格外顯眼。

examples.en: Red apples taste sweet and crisp in autumn.
examples.zh: 秋天的紅蘋果吃起來又甜又脆。

examples.en: The ocean looks deep blue today.
examples.zh: 今天的海洋看起來一片深藍。

examples.en: She wore a lovely sky-blue dress to the party.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件漂亮的天藍色洋裝去參加派對。

examples.en: Whenever I feel blue, listening to gentle music cheers me up.
examples.zh: 每當我心情沮喪時，聽輕柔的音樂總能讓我振作起來。

examples.en: School buses in the US are bright yellow.
examples.zh: 美國的校車是亮黃色的。

examples.en: Sunflowers turned their yellow faces towards the warm sun.
examples.zh: 向日葵把黃色的花盤朝向溫暖的太陽。

examples.en: She highlighted the important keywords with a yellow marker.
examples.zh: 她用黃色螢光筆畫出重要關鍵字。

examples.en: Eat more green vegetables to stay healthy.
examples.zh: 多吃綠色蔬菜以保持健康。

examples.en: The hills turn vibrant green during springtime.
examples.zh: 春天時山丘轉變為生機盎然的翠綠色。

examples.en: Many people choose public transit to support green living.
examples.zh: 許多人選擇大眾運輸來支持綠色環保生活。

examples.en: He wore a black jacket to the party.
examples.zh: 他穿了一件黑色夾克去參加聚會。

examples.en: The teacher wrote key concepts with chalk on the black board.
examples.zh: 老師用粉筆在黑板上寫下核心概念。

examples.en: My father prefers his coffee black without any sugar.
examples.zh: 我父親喜歡喝不加糖的黑咖啡。

examples.en: White snow covered the mountain top.
examples.zh: 白雪覆蓋了山頂。

examples.en: Please write your answers on a blank sheet of white paper.
examples.zh: 請將答案寫在一張空白的白紙上。

examples.en: The doctor wore a clean white lab coat.
examples.zh: 醫生穿著一件乾淨的白長袍。

examples.en: The sunset painted the sky orange and gold.
examples.zh: 夕陽把天空染成了橘金雙色。

examples.en: Eating an orange provides your body with rich vitamin C.
examples.zh: 吃一顆柳橙能為身體提供豐富的維生素 C。

examples.en: Road construction workers wear bright orange safety vests.
examples.zh: 道路施工人員穿著鮮橘色的反光安全背心。

examples.en: The puppy has lovely brown eyes.
examples.zh: 這隻小狗有一對可愛的棕色眼睛。

examples.en: Dry leaves turned brown and fell gently from the trees.
examples.zh: 枯葉變成了褐色，從樹上輕輕飄落。

examples.en: He wore a stylish pair of dark brown leather shoes.
examples.zh: 他穿了一雙時髦的深棕色皮鞋。

examples.en: Cherry blossoms are lovely shades of pink.
examples.zh: 櫻花呈現出可愛的粉紅色調。

examples.en: The baby girl was wrapped in a soft pink blanket.
examples.zh: 女嬰被包裹在一條柔軟的粉紅色毛毯裡。

examples.en: Flamingos get their bright pink color from the food they eat.
examples.zh: 紅鶴明亮的粉紅色澤源自牠們所吃的食物。

examples.en: Lavender flowers have a nice purple color.
examples.zh: 薰衣草花朵擁有美麗的紫色。

examples.en: The evening sky slowly faded into deep purple before nightfall.
examples.zh: 傍晚的天空在入夜前逐漸轉變為深紫色。

examples.en: She picked a bunch of ripe purple grapes from the vineyard.
examples.zh: 她從葡萄園摘了一串熟成的紫葡萄。

words.definition: 灰色的；灰色（英式常用 grey）

examples.en: The sky turned gray before the thunderstorm.
examples.zh: 雷陣雨前天空變成了灰色。

examples.en: My grandfather has distinguished silver-gray hair.
examples.zh: 我爺爺有一頭顯眼的銀灰色頭髮。

examples.en: Concrete buildings lined both sides of the gray city street.
examples.zh: 灰暗的城市街道兩旁矗立著混凝土建築。

examples.en: What is your favorite color?
examples.zh: 你最喜歡什麼顏色？

examples.en: The garden is full of vibrant flowers in every color imaginable.
examples.zh: 花園裡開滿了各式各樣顏色鮮豔的花朵。

examples.en: The artist mixed blue and yellow to create a new green color.
examples.zh: 畫家將藍色與黃色調和以創造出嶄新的綠色。

examples.en: Wear a helmet to protect your head.
examples.zh: 戴上安全帽以保護你的頭部。

examples.en: He nodded his head in agreement with the teacher's suggestion.
examples.zh: 他點頭贊成老師的建議。

examples.en: After dinner, we decided to head for the night market.
examples.zh: 晚餐後，我們決定前往夜市。

examples.en: Close your eyes and make a wish.
examples.zh: 閉上你的眼睛並許個願。

examples.en: She looked into my eyes and smiled warmly.
examples.zh: 她注視著我的眼睛並溫暖地微笑了。

examples.en: Please keep an eye on my backpack while I buy a drink.
examples.zh: 我去買杯飲料時，請幫忙照看我的背包。

examples.en: Dogs have a very sensitive nose.
examples.zh: 狗擁有非常靈敏的鼻子。

examples.en: I caught a cold and have a runny nose today.
examples.zh: 我感冒了，今天一直流鼻水。

examples.en: The sweet scent of jasmine tickled her nose.
examples.zh: 茉莉花的清甜香氣輕輕撲向她的鼻息。

examples.en: Open your mouth so the doctor can check.
examples.zh: 張開你的嘴巴讓醫生檢查。

examples.en: Don't speak with your mouth full of food.
examples.zh: 嘴裡塞滿食物時不要說話。

examples.en: A wide smile spread across the little boy's mouth.
examples.zh: 小男孩的嘴角揚起了燦爛的微笑。

examples.en: Rabbits have long, cute ears.
examples.zh: 兔子有著長長可愛的耳朵。

examples.en: Whisper the secret softly into my ear so no one else hears.
examples.zh: 悄悄把秘密對我耳語，這樣別人才聽不到。

examples.en: He listened to music through his wireless earphones.
examples.zh: 他透過無線耳機聆聽音樂。

examples.en: Wash your face with warm water.
examples.zh: 用溫水洗洗你的臉。

examples.en: A cheerful smile appeared on her face when she saw the gift.
examples.zh: 當她看到禮物時，臉上露出了開朗的笑容。

examples.en: We must stay brave and face whatever challenges lie ahead.
examples.zh: 我們必須保持勇敢，勇於面對眼前的一切挑戰。

examples.en: Always wash your hands before meals.
examples.zh: 飯前務必記得洗手。

examples.en: Raise your hand if you know the answer to this question.
examples.zh: 如果你知道這道題目的答案，請舉手。

examples.en: Please hand in your assignment before noon tomorrow.
examples.zh: 請在明天中午前繳交你的作業。

examples.en: He broke his arm during the baseball game.
examples.zh: 他在棒球比賽中摔斷了手臂。

examples.en: She held the sleeping baby safely in her arms.
examples.zh: 她將熟睡的嬰兒安穩抱在懷裡。

examples.en: Lift both arms above your head during the stretch.
examples.zh: 伸展時請將雙臂高舉過頭。

examples.en: My legs feel tired after climbing the stairs.
examples.zh: 爬完樓梯後我的雙腿感到很痠。

examples.en: He stretched his legs during the long flight to relax.
examples.zh: 在長途飛行途中他伸展雙腿以放鬆身心。

examples.en: Flamingos often stand on one slender leg in shallow water.
examples.zh: 紅鶴在淺水中經常單腿獨立。

examples.en: My feet hurt after standing all day.
examples.zh: 站了一整天後我的雙腳很痛。

examples.en: We explored the old mountain village entirely on foot.
examples.zh: 我們完全徒步探索這座古老山城。

examples.en: The basketball player stands over six feet tall.
examples.zh: 這位籃球運動員身高超過六英呎。

examples.en: Each hand has five fingers.
examples.zh: 每隻手有五隻手指。

examples.en: Be careful not to cut your finger while slicing vegetables.
examples.zh: 切蔬菜時請小心不要切到手指。

examples.en: Keep your fingers crossed that our school team wins the final match.
examples.zh: 祈求好運，祝願我們校隊能贏得決賽。

examples.en: Regular exercise keeps your body strong.
examples.zh: 規律運動能保持身體強健。

examples.en: Water makes up about sixty percent of the human body.
examples.zh: 水分大約佔了人體重量的百分之六十。

examples.en: Good posture keeps your body and spine healthy.
examples.zh: 良好的體態能維護身體與脊椎健康。

examples.en: Exercise makes your heart pump faster.
examples.zh: 運動能讓你的心跳加速。

examples.en: She thanked her teacher from the bottom of her heart.
examples.zh: 她由衷地打從心底感謝她的老師。

examples.en: The student drew a small pink heart next to her friend's name.
examples.zh: 這位學生在好友的名字旁畫了一顆小小的粉紅愛心。

examples.en: Good health is the greatest wealth.
examples.zh: 良好的健康是最大的財富。

examples.en: Drinking clean water and sleeping well protect your overall health.
examples.zh: 飲用潔淨水與充足睡眠能守護你的整體健康。

examples.en: Public health guidelines helped keep the school safe.
examples.zh: 公共衛生指引有助於維護校園的安全。

examples.en: Eating vegetables helps you stay healthy.
examples.zh: 多吃蔬菜能幫助你維持健康。

examples.en: Maintaining a healthy diet gives you abundant energy throughout the day.
examples.zh: 維持健康的飲食能讓你在整天保持充沛活力。

examples.en: Regular jogging is a very healthy lifestyle habit.
examples.zh: 規律慢跑是一項非常健康的生活習慣。

examples.en: If you feel sick, stay home and rest.
examples.zh: 如果你感到不舒服，請留在家中休息。

examples.en: He took two days of sick leave because of a high fever.
examples.zh: 他因為高燒請了兩天的病假。

examples.en: I felt car sick on the winding mountain roads.
examples.zh: 在蜿蜒的山路上我感到有些暈車。

examples.en: You should see a doctor if your fever continues.
examples.zh: 如果你發燒持續，應該去看醫生。

examples.en: The doctor examined the patient's throat and prescribed medicine.
examples.zh: 醫生檢查了病人的喉嚨並開立處方藥。

examples.en: My elder sister wants to become an eye doctor.
examples.zh: 我的姊姊想成為一名眼科醫生。

examples.en: The hospital is just two blocks away.
examples.zh: 醫院距離這裡只有兩條街。

examples.en: The injured cyclist was immediately rushed to the nearest hospital.
examples.zh: 受傷的自行車騎士被立刻緊急送往最近的醫院。

examples.en: Volunteers visited the hospital to read cheerful books to sick children.
examples.zh: 志工們走訪醫院，為生病的小朋友朗讀歡樂的故事書。
